title: Made-in-China Product & Supplier Scraper Input
description: Find unique Made-in-China suppliers using product keywords, uploaded product images, or public image URLs. Choose one search mode and complete its matching section; fields for the other mode are ignored. For batch duration, use Apify's native Timeout setting in Run options.

searchMode.title: Search mode
searchMode.description: Choose Keyword search for product terms or Image search for uploaded files and public image URLs.

searchTerms.title: Product keywords
searchTerms.description: Used only in Keyword search. Add one specific product query per row, such as stainless steel glass shower hinge. Image searches ignore this field.
searchTerms.sectionDescription: These fields are used only when Search mode is Keyword search. Enter at least one product keyword before starting the run.

maxUniqueSuppliersPerKeyword.title: Maximum suppliers per keyword
maxUniqueSuppliersPerKeyword.description: Maximum number of unique suppliers collected separately for each keyword. This is not a limit for the whole batch.

maxPagesText.title: Maximum pages per keyword
maxPagesText.description: Maximum Made-in-China result pages processed for each keyword. The Actor stops sooner when the supplier target is reached; higher values take more time.

uploadedImages.title: Product images
uploadedImages.description: Used only in Image search. Upload up to 20 clear JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or BMP product images. Each image is searched separately. WebP and GIF files are converted automatically. To use public web images, add them below.
uploadedImages.sectionDescription: These fields are used only when Search mode is Image search. Add at least one uploaded image or public image URL before starting the run.

imageUrls.title: Public product image URLs
imageUrls.description: Used only in Image search and recommended for MCP/API clients. Add one direct, publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS image URL per row. Uploaded files and URLs share a combined limit of 20 images.

maxUniqueSuppliersPerImage.title: Maximum suppliers per image
maxUniqueSuppliersPerImage.description: Maximum number of unique suppliers collected separately for each uploaded image or public image URL. This is not a limit for the whole batch.

maxPagesImage.title: Maximum result batches per image
maxPagesImage.description: Maximum image-result batches processed separately for each image. Each batch contains up to 20 products and the website currently provides at most five batches. The Actor stops sooner when the supplier target is reached.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Recommended, especially for larger keyword or image batches, because Made-in-China may limit or challenge direct traffic.
useApifyProxy.sectionDescription: Shared behavior for keyword and image searches.

includeSupplierDetails.title: Include supplier profile details
includeSupplierDetails.description: Visit every accepted public supplier profile to add business type, main products, location, establishment information, employee count, address, member history, rating, response time, and company description. Disable for faster listing-only runs.

skipFailedImages.title: Skip failed images
skipFailedImages.description: Used only in Image search. Continue with remaining images when one image cannot be downloaded, converted, uploaded, or searched. Disable to fail immediately.

failOnNoResults.title: Strict failure mode
failOnNoResults.description: Enable for automations that should fail when the full run produces no usable supplier rows. Leave disabled to finish with a warning, keep successful inputs, and save diagnostics.

saveCsvFile.title: Save CSV files
saveCsvFile.description: Save CSV files in the run's key-value store. Enabled by default so every run creates a named file in addition to the structured Apify dataset. The CSV settings below are ignored when this is disabled.
saveCsvFile.sectionDescription: Optional file exports. Dataset output is always available.

csvOutputMode.title: CSV output mode
csvOutputMode.description: Used only when Save CSV files is enabled. Choose one combined file, one file per keyword or image, or both.

csvFilename.title: Combined CSV filename
csvFilename.description: Used only for Combined CSV or Combined and separate files. Separate-only exports use filenames derived from each keyword or image.
